title: Hardware & Software: Operating Systems & Apps
welcome_lead: The OS is the team captain — apps play their position.
meta_desc: KS3 software: operating systems, applications and utilities.
final_note: An OS makes one set of hardware feel like many possible computers.

concepts.def: Software that manages hardware and apps.

walkthroughs.body_html: The operating system shares the CPU, manages memory, talks to devices and runs apps. Examples: Windows, macOS, Linux, Android, iOS.
Apps do user jobs — write a doc, edit a photo. Utilities keep the computer healthy — backup, antivirus, file compression.
A GUI uses icons and windows. A CLI uses typed commands. CLIs are powerful for experts; GUIs are friendly for everyone.
